brief.playerPromise: Read a changing estuary through the instruments of the people studying it.

direction.topology: A short loop from the landing to an instrument deck and back along a sheltered walkway
direction.signature: Align two observation periods and watch their recorded salinity profiles separate above the water
direction.whyThisContent: The spatial comparison makes an existing field study legible; it invents no scientific findings.

zones.purpose: Meet the researcher, choose direct reading or exploration
zones.landmark: Field notebook beside a lit tide gauge

stations.feedback: Labeled ribbons separate and the numeric difference is announced in the DOM
stations.stateChange: The selected comparison remains visible until changed
stations.reset: Restore the initial pair or exit without saving

beats.action: Return to the study and researcher
beats.reward: Understand the source behind the spectacle

share.hook: One adjustment separates two documented tidal profiles
share.capture: A real 12-second interaction, then the study attribution; reframe for portrait rather than shrinking the HUD

budget.device: Agreed reference laptop; measure before locking budgets
